rules.statement: An agreement to pool profits from opium sales, where the partners are all licensed individuals and do not involve unlicensed persons in the sale, is not illegal under the Opium Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Since writing the above I have seen the judgment of my brother Ennis, and I may say that I am in entire agreement with him. Of course my decision is that the agreement is ex facie valid. There is nothing in its terms that can be said to contravene any provision of the law"
